Beekie.text: The most systematic bettor in the group, and so far the unluckiest. All four bets are 5-point, three-leg long-shot parlays pairing a game total with two star scorers' points, two all-over and two all-under, and six of his eight props are on guards. He never bets sides, singles or alt lines, spent his weekly boost on a +608 parlay, and placed all four in one sitting about six hours before tip. Only 3 of 12 legs have hit, so 0-4 for -20, though the tiny stakes keep it cheap. Read: a game-script parlay builder who needs everything to break together.

Kev.text: Three bets, three wins, +43, all of them singles near even money on sides: Portland +2.5, the boosted Portland moneyline at +108, then Houston -8.5 with a 20-point stake, his biggest yet. Every bet has been on a road team and two of three on underdogs, and he has never touched a total, a prop or an alt line. He bets about seven and a half hours before tip, never in the final hour, and has not copied Claude once. Everything has worked so far; the one new wrinkle is doubling his stake on a road favorite. Read: a road-side bettor who trusts his own number.

Mio.text: Small sample, but a sharp signature: two-leg parlays at 30 to 50 points, the biggest stakes in the group, with three of four legs alternate lines bought down to safer numbers (Over 219.5, Lakers +10.5, Brunson Pts+Reb+Ast over 29.5) so each slip lands at a favorite's price. All four legs hit for 2-0 and +52, the best net in the book, though at those stakes one bad leg would hand a lot of it back. Read: a grinder who buys safety.

Sulliver.text: Sulliver leans on Claude more than anyone: four of his six settled bets came from Claude's picks of the day, including Golden State +3.5, his only win. His own instinct is star props, and all seven of his prop legs have been overs, split between guards and forwards, but only two have hit. Alt lines are 0-3, whether he bought a safer number on Shai or reached for Wembanyama threes at +220, and both parlays missed, one boosted to +547. Stakes stay at 5 to 10 points. Singles 1-3, parlays 0-2, -26 overall. Read: a Claude follower with an itch for star overs.
